narr: Storms developed along a weak surface boundary within a moisture-rich environment with weak mean-layer flow. Slow moving storms produced rainfall rates of 3 to 4 inches per hour, with amounts of 3.09 inches reported by a cooperative weather observer near Wakefield and personal automated gauges and radar estimates up to 4 inches over portions of the Sioux City metro area.
ev: Several streets were flooded around the city with water ranging from curb depth to as high as the tops of tires at numerous locations. The worst flooded locations included Nicollet Street, East 23rd Street, Garretson Avenue, Hennepin Street, and Jackson Street. Pulaski Park was also flooded.
Numerous manhole covers were displaced throughout the city from overwhelmed storm drain systems and the outpouring of water.
